description: Persona photo + device mock + text panel — the photo-led house style (KSIA/BAT reference). Encodes the non-skippable imagery rules: persona layer on every device slide (or data-no-persona reason), scene-beat-derived Firefly prompt, face never covered by the mock, 6-stop seamless panel-to-photo blend, min type scale. Use for any scene slide where the persona experiences a device moment.
